reason: Corpus has no rules on documents or signature legalization for sole proprietorship registration; OR 556/597 cover partnerships only, OR 943 is a pointer to the ordinance.
No fee amounts in the acts; ZGB 954 only allows cantons to levy land register fees (pointer), notary fees are cantonal.
Corpus covers only civil liability of animal keepers (OR 56); no criminal sanctions or official dog measures in the 8 acts.
ZGB 715 only requires entry in the register kept by the debt enforcement office; documents and fee are not in the corpus (SchKG fees delegated).
OR 267 only states normal-use return standard; no lifespan of carpets anywhere in the corpus.
ZGB 656/666 only mention expropriation and refer to federal and cantonal expropriation law (pointer); no compensation rules.
VVG Art. 12 is repealed (empty) and no in-force article sets a correction deadline for the policy; plausible question based on the old rule.
ZGB 688 is a pointer leaving planting distances to cantons; no distances or heights in the corpus.
No residence permit or family reunification rules in the acts; ZGB 98/99 only concern proof of residence for the marriage procedure.
ZGB 619 is only a pointer to the Rural Land Law; the income-value assignment rule is not stated in the corpus.
